title: bhf.finding.v1
description: Envelope every <work>/results/findings/<id>/finding.json carries. Producer-specific fields are open; bhf.findings.v1 is the normalized view.

build.description: Build facts of the harness that produced the finding. `fidelity` is present when the harness compiled only after bhf supplied headers, macro values or types the build context lacked.

gates.description: Comparison evidence recorded by replaying the finding's input (gate_capture.input): each input span whose bytes reached a comparison of the target.

site_unattributable.description: site is the sanitizer's memcmp/bcmp interceptor and the code that called it could not be named; absent (false) otherwise.

gate_capture.description: How the comparison evidence in gates was recorded, or why there is none.

runner.description: The emulator the capture replayed a harness built for another platform under (qemu-aarch64); absent for a native replay.

derived_search.description: How far the search for operands computed from input bytes (range checks such as width - 1 > 31) got: done, partial (the replay budget ran out) or too_long (the input was too long to search). Absent when no such search ran, and in captures recorded before it was kept.

searched_bytes.description: The input bytes that derived_search covered, of input_len.

input_reachability_basis.description: Why the static reachability label (input_reachability) was given: the rule that decided it and, for a parameter-shape rule, the parameter and its type. Absent when the label is not the classifier's own, and in findings recorded before it was kept.

resolved_type.description: The type with its typedefs resolved, when that differs from the spelling.

typedefs_resolved.description: The classifier read the parameter types with typedefs resolved (at least one parameter's type changed).

decoded_args.description: The arguments the harness decoded from the input and passed to the target (and the receiver object of a method), when traced.

decoder.description: The receiver entry only: how the harness built the object (default constructor, factory Widget::make(), ...).

span.description: [start, end) byte offsets of the input the argument came from.

build.description: How the harness that produced the finding was built.

binary.description: The harness binary's identity; null when it could not be read.

coverage_instrumentation.description: The instrumentation that fed the edge map, read from the binary; absent when the binary does not show one.

harness.description: The input format of the generated harness that found it. Readers prefer it to the older top-level harness_format_version and buffer_len_dimension, which are still written.
